verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents an API endpoint that creates a transaction and runs payment screening, and payment screening cases exist as an exportable record type. That shows the core screening capability is first-party. Case review and decisions are documented only generically for screening and monitoring alerts, not specifically for payment hits. missing for 10: documented pre-release hold/release flow for payments, payment-specific decision output and inspection of supporting matches, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can screen a payment before release and inspect the decision and its supporting matches

citations.quote: Creates a transaction and executes our payment screening and transaction monitoring processes.
Cases, alerts and risks can be reviewed and remediated either via the ComplyAdvantage Mesh web application or by integrating with the API for use in your own case management system.
